prompt: RimWorld game creature sprite: the muttavaq, a canyon-floor giant that sleeps for years beneath a cracked clay pan and wakes when the flood reaches it — a vast low-slung body plated in dried-clay polygons that match the pan it slept under, a broad shovel head with straining jaw-plates for feeding like a walking weir in floodwater, thick pillar legs caked to the knee in wet clay, small deep-set eyes, wax-sheened seams where its burrow lining still clings. It reads as a piece of the cracked flats that stood up and started wading. No nameable Earth animal.
